name: CSV Parse
description: Parse CSV into structured rows. Provide the source ONE of three ways: path (an absolute file path on the Hearth host), data_url (a data:text/csv;base64,… inline payload), or collateral_id (a CSV previously saved to Collateral). Optional: max_rows (cap returned rows). Returns headers + rows (array of objects) plus a row count.
author: hearth-team
